About the union

Technology brings our schools together.

HKJSTU is run by students, for students. We make room for practical learning and new connections beyond any one campus.

Why we exist

Secondary-school students should not have to explore technology alone. HKJSTU connects local and international school communities so young people can learn from different perspectives and make things together.

Our mission is to bridge gaps between schools, empower young people, and create positive social impact through technology.

Learn by taking part

From a first workshop to a finished project, every format is built around doing.

Competitions and hackathons

Turn challenges into projects, prototypes, or proposals.

Workshops and seminars

Develop practical knowledge and technical skills together.

Industry visits

See how technology organisations work and explore future pathways.

Showcases and networking

Present student work and connect with other school communities.

Our common ground

  • Innovation
  • Integrity
  • Inclusivity
  • Mutual respect
